description_sq:
Shesim godine 3 kate me parkim dhe papafingo
Godina eshte e vendosur ne 1000m2 truall me njolle ndertimi 260m2 per secilin kat ndersa papafingo ka siperfaqe 200m2 te brendshme dhe 60m2 verande.
Vila eshte e organizuar ne:
Kati -1 i cili sherben si parkim;
Kati 0, 1 dhe 2 jane open space te cilat mund te organizohen sipas deshires;
Kati i trete eshte papafingo open space si dhe 60m2 verande.
Godina ndodhet ne zonen e Linzes, prane rruges kryesore ne koder me nje pamje nga Tirana.
Per nje vizite ne prone jeni te mirepritur.
title_en: Godine for sale, 3 floors + attic + parking
description_en: We are selling a 3-storey building with parking and an attic. The building is located on a 1000m2 plot with a construction area of ​​260m2 for each floor, while the attic has an interior surface of 200m2 and a 60m2 veranda. The villa is organized in: Floor -1 which serves as parking; Floors 0, 1 and 2 are open spaces that can be organized as desired; The third floor is an open space attic and a 60m2 veranda. The building is located in the Linze area, near the main road on the hill with a view of Tirana. You are welcome to visit the property.
